title: T-4 JWT validator is the sole reader of the Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion header in the applied source tree
asA: shelf consumer applying the edge-cloudflare-access v1.0.0 blueprint on a Workers project using the cf-edge fixture
iWant: only src/jwt-validator.mjs to dereference the Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion header string in the applied source tree
soThat: the validator is the single seam and a stray header read in the applied code is a defect the AST scan catches

acceptanceCriteria.description: The sole-reader scan walks the fixture applied source root (src/**/*.mjs), strips comments and string literals, and finds exactly one live source occurrence of the header string Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion, in src/jwt-validator.mjs. Any other occurrence in a shipped module fails the probe.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the cf-edge fixture applied source tree
acceptanceCriteria.then: the only live-source hit for Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion is in src/jwt-validator.mjs; SIMULATE_NON_VALIDATOR_HEADER=true injects a second hit and the probe fails
